lines.l: Don't shed your tears in vain
I know that I love you, child, and honestly I do
And you will be my wife, and forever you will be
Don't you ever cry, don't try to hypnotize, no, my love
Even when you're lonely, I will be there to comfort you, my darling
Don't try to hit my fight
I will be there to comfort you, my darling
So don't you ever cry, don't shed your tears in vain
Tomorrow you'll be there, engage on waiting for me
I know that I love you, smile, and I will sleep, I do
And you will be my wife
Don't shed your tears in vain
